mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% (measured via 60-day rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0 (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 750 thousand units and retail sales below 400 billion dollars indicates broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition HOUST < 750 and RSAFS < 400000 fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 98 (index 2017=100) signals robust supply expansion that boosts corporate output and profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 98 (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate rising above 0.10% signals early monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.10 (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increase and CPI decline indicates disinflationary monetary tightening that reduces real interest rates and stimulates equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL falling fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening with strong labor market (FEDFUNDS > 0.10 and UNRATE < 5.0) increases real interest rates and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.10 and UNRATE < 5.0 (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 750 thousand units signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 750 (over 3-year rolling window).
